Why it matters here

Colorado is hard on outdoor surfaces

At altitude, the same patio sees more intense UV, sharper temperature swings, and dozens of freeze-thaw cycles a year. Sealing is the difference between a surface that fades and flakes and one that still looks new in a decade.

UV & fading

Thin mountain air lets more UV through. A quality sealer blocks fading and keeps concrete and pavers from going chalky and gray.

Freeze-thaw cracking

Water seeps in, freezes, and pries surfaces apart. Sealing keeps moisture out so your patio doesn't spall, pit, or crack from the inside.

Stains & weeds

Sealer resists oil, grease, leaf tannins, and efflorescence, and locks paver joints so weeds and ants stay out from between the stones.

The difference

Dull and weathered, brought back to life

Sealing doesn't just protect — it transforms. Colors come back rich and saturated, the surface gets an even finish, and the whole space reads cared-for.

Richer, deeper color (matte or wet-look)
Easier to sweep and rinse clean
Years of added life on the surface

What we seal

Every kind of patio surface

Concrete & Stamped

Poured slabs, broom-finish, and stamped concrete. We clean, treat stains, and seal for a clean matte or subtle sheen that resists fading and pitting.

Pavers

Brick and concrete pavers, fully cleaned with joint sand refreshed and locked in. Stops weeds, ants, and shifting while bringing the color back.

Natural Stone

Flagstone, travertine, and slate. Gentle, stone-appropriate sealers that protect against staining and weathering without trapping moisture.
